answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network erects a beacon of verifiable identity using quadratic stake slashing: registering N autonomous agents requires burning stake scaling superlinearly as O(N²). Each agent signs its epoch commitment with a cryptographic quill; if correlated malicious behaviors surge like an adversarial tide, slashing burns the pooled stake exponentially, imposing unsustainable economic friction that bankrupts coordinated Sybil attackers.
